children: NEW YORK, Sept 10 (Reuters) - The amount of U.S. commercial paper contracted in the week ended Sept 9 Federal Reserve data showed on Thursday.    U.S. seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding fell $4.5 billion to $1.437 trillion in the latest week.    Non-seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding - which some analysts consider a more reliable reading than the seasonally adjusted one since it has been distorted by the financial crisis - fell $19.5 billion to $1.434 trillion.    U.S. non-seasonally adjusted foreign financial commercial paper outstanding fell $3.6 billion to $349.1 billion.
